$ twaco mashup gap --help
exit: 0

--- stdout
  mashup gap <mashup> <container> <px> [--apply] [--json]
                              replace direct twaco spacers with fixed gaps (0 removes; 0..200px);
                              run again after adding children; plan unless --apply

  --log <filter>              write diagnostic logs to stderr (or TWACO_LOG)
  --log-file <path>           append diagnostic logs to a file (or TWACO_LOG_FILE)
--- stderr
